name: comp-330
blurb: Modal for selecting a new subscription plan with pricing and features.
description: A shadcn Dialog with radio-button plan selector (Essential, Standard, Enterprise) and a checklist of included features.
use_when: Allowing existing users to upgrade or downgrade their subscription plan with transparent pricing.
avoid_when: With many plans or complex feature differences — the dialog is optimized for simple 3-plan choices.
a11y: Plan radio buttons have aria-describedby for pricing; labels properly associated; checkmarks are aria-hidden; full keyboard navigation.
